task_completion.description: The MRHead brain MRI dataset is loaded into the 3D Slicer application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D Slicer interface shows the 'MRHead' volume in the slice viewers (Red, Green, Yellow).

task_completion.description: The agent navigates to the mid-sagittal plane for measurement.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The sagittal slice viewer (usually the Yellow slice) shows a clear view of the corpus callosum at the midline, with the brainstem and septum pellucidum visible.

task_completion.description: Measurement markups (lines or points) are placed on the corpus callosum for length and thickness.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Visual markup lines or rulers are visible on the corpus callosum in the sagittal view, indicating measurements for total length and thickness at the genu, body, and splenium.

task_completion.description: The measurement markups are saved to the specified JSON file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save Data' dialog or a file browser shows 'cc_measurements.mrk.json' being saved to ~/Documents/SlicerData/SampleData/.

task_completion.description: A report JSON file is created with the required morphometry fields.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows the creation of 'corpus_callosum_report.json' containing fields: total_length_mm, genu_thickness_mm, body_thickness_mm, splenium_thickness_mm, mid_sagittal_slice, and atrophy_grade.

integrity.description: The agent used the 3D Slicer GUI to perform measurements rather than just script execution.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Slicer's 'Markups' or 'Ruler' tools and manual placement of points on the MRI.

integrity.description: The measurements in the report correspond to the visual markups in the GUI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The values in the final JSON report (e.g., total_length_mm) are consistent with the lengths shown in the Slicer 'Markups' control panel or on-screen labels.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply copy a pre-existing report file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen actively typing the report values or using a script that extracts values from the active Slicer session.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The MRHead sample volume in 3D Slicer typically has a mid-sagittal plane around slice index 125-130 in the sagittal view. A normal corpus callosum length is approximately 70-80mm. The report must be saved in ~/Documents/SlicerData/SampleData/ and must include the specific field 'atrophy_grade' which requires the agent to make a qualitative assessment based on the measurements.
